Which statement describes the formation of bonds in lithium bromide?
A
A lithium atom donates one electron to a bromine atom.
B
A bromine atom donates one electron to a lithium atom.
C
A lithium atom shares a pair of electrons with a bromine atom.
D
A bromine atom donates a pair of electrons to a lithium atom.

options.label: A
options.text: A lithium atom donates one electron to a bromine atom.

options.label: B

options.label: C
